qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for coupling bolts for hydraulic pipes?
What torque should be applied when connecting the master cylinder to console?
What is the torque value for the master cylinder setscrew?
How much torque should be applied to the master cylinder to pedal assembly connection?
What is the specified torque for the slave cylinder to clutch housing or transmission case?
Which hydraulic clutch component has the lowest torque specification?
qa_pairs.answer: The master cylinder to pedal assembly at 10 Nm

qa_pairs.question: Do all the hydraulic clutch components use the same screw type?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes, all components are listed as using 'All' type screws

qa_pairs.question: What torque specifications have the same value of 22 Nm?
qa_pairs.answer: Master cylinder to console, master cylinder setscrew, and slave cylinder to clutch housing or transmission case all require 22 Nm

qa_pairs.question: What section and subsection does this torque specification table cover?
Which hydraulic clutch component requires the highest torque specification?
qa_pairs.answer: Three components share the highest specification at 22 Nm: master cylinder to console, master cylinder setscrew, and slave cylinder to clutch housing or transmission case
